Install & offline play

Keep TURN ready for your next drive.

Install TURN

Open TURN in your device’s browser and follow the install page. On iPhone or iPad, use Safari’s Share menu and Add to Home Screen. Launch the installed icon to play.

Let setup finish

The loading screen prepares the game and its offline files. Keep the connection available until it reaches the game. Later starts can use the saved game offline.

Updates

Loading handles updates and restarts when needed. Let the new version finish preparing before cutting the connection. Sharing a new YOUR TURN challenge still needs a connection.

If a start fails

Use the loading screen’s recovery action. Reconnect if the offline files are incomplete. Avoid clearing browser data as a first response: local progress and recordings live on the device.
